Coming to vertical-wise commentary,  
Enterprise Lending: which is a business consisting of Unsecured Loans, Loan against Property, 
and Gold Loans – Q2 disbursements for the segment grew by 25.5% YoY. Disbursements for 
LAP + EBL, which is our mortgage book, grew by 30% YoY, and we anticipate this upward 
trajectory to continue.  
 
Our Gold Loan disbursements grew over 60% YoY. Gold loan is positioned for continued 
traction in the coming quarters.  
Our Unsecured Business Loans business returned to sequential growth trajectory this quarter. 
We expect momentum to continue in unsecured business loans going forward as well.  
Portfolio quality and collections were stable for Enterprise Lending.  
 
On Asset Finance: Our Commercial Vehicle book registered a moderate growth of 8% YoY, 
while our Construction Equipment book grew by 12% in the same period. Festive season 
demand led by increasing last-mile volume, post-monsoon pickup in construction activity, and 
stable fleet utilization levels augur well for Asset Finance business as we enter H2 with 
confidence.  
We did notice some seasonality effect in our asset quality in asset finance in line with 
expectations. We expect this to normalize in the coming months.  
 
Consumer Finance: Disbursements for Consumer Finance vertical grew over 25% YoY, while 
the book expanded 22% YoY.  
Consumer Durables book, which consists of loans for purchase of consumer durables and digital 
products, that book grew by 49% YoY, and the Auto Loan book grew by 22% YoY.  
 
Our Relationship PL, which is our cross-sell product to our customers, grew by 16% YoY.  
Portfolio quality and collections were stable for the Consumer Finance vertical. So, the festive 
season is expected to be a big fillip for this business.  
Overall, in Q2, our disbursements continued on growth trajectory, growing by 18% YoY. Our 
profit after tax grew 34% YoY. Conversations with our channel and OEM partners indicate 
strong confidence on the back of festive demand, and we look forward to a strong H2.

updates in terms of the outcomes we are seeing in some of our focus areas.

time it takes to onboard a customer. That has started for our consumer finance

larger ecosystem.
